Orange  Spider.  Araneidese.

A  small  spider  known  to  people  as  very  poisonous,  chiefly  found  in  the  island  of
urapoa.

This  spider,  about  the  size  of  a  cherry  stone,  is  found  upon  orange  trees  in  the
West  Indies.  When  young  it  is  velvety-black  in  appearance,  marked  with  antero-
posterior lines  composed  of  white  dots ;  on  posterior  part  of  body  there  are  three
orange-red  spots,  while  upon  belly  there  is  a  large  square  yellow  spot. — Am.
Hom.  Pliarmacopoea.

The  alcoholic  tincture  is  prepared  from  the  live  spider  crushed.
